title: 4-20 mA pressure loop
goal: Show one unbroken two-wire 4-20 mA series loop from supply through transmitter, sense resistor, PLC input, and return.

rubric.must: A 24 VDC loop supply rated 100 mA is visible.
One continuous series path runs from the loop supply through the transmitter, sense resistor, PLC input, and back to the supply.
A labelled two-wire pressure transmitter with a 4-20 mA rating is visible.
Numbered field-out and field-return terminal blocks are visibly placed in the loop wiring.
A clearly labelled 250 ohm sense resistor is visible in series before the PLC analogue input.
Two labelled test points and a hand-held 4-20 mA meter connection are shown across the sense point.
Reference designators and ratings remain legible beside their corresponding instrument parts.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. One series loop: supply + through TB1 to the transmitter, transmitter - through TB2 to the 250 ohm sense resistor, then into the PLC analogue input and back to the supply -; the hand-held meter hangs across the sense resistor at TP1/TP2 and does not bypass it.
